name: tenderloop
description: Your tender playbook, deadlines, case records and saved opportunities.

interface.longDescription: Manage your workspace playbook, tender records, deadlines and saved opportunities in your assistant. Connect with TenderLoop OAuth to review your workspace and record results you have verified on official procurement portals.
capabilities: Read and update the tender instructions saved in your connected workspace
Review recorded tender deadlines, next actions and evidence links
Track and review saved opportunities before filing
Record a tender outcome after verifying it on the official procurement portal
defaultPrompt: Show my upcoming tender deadlines and next actions.
Summarize the tender instructions in my workspace.
List my saved open tender opportunities.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies connector setup, approved workspace access and using recorded evidence from the official procurement portal.

es-ES.subtitle: Tus notas y tu registro
es-ES.description: Consulta las instrucciones guardadas, los plazos registrados y las oportunidades de tu espacio de trabajo. Conecta tu cuenta de TenderLoop y guarda el resultado cuando lo hayas verificado en el portal oficial de contratación.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vos notes et votre registre
fr-FR.description: Consultez vos critères enregistrés, les échéances et les opportunités de votre espace de travail. Connectez votre compte TenderLoop et consignez les résultats que vous avez vérifiés sur le portail officiel.

positive.prompt: Summarize the tender instructions saved in my TenderLoop workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the connected workspace’s saved review instructions.

positive.prompt: Show the upcoming TenderLoop deadlines and next actions that are recorded.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recorded deadlines and next actions, or report that the board is empty.

positive.prompt: List the tender cases recorded in my TenderLoop workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the rows and any next page, or accurately report that there are no recorded cases.

positive.prompt: Show the open opportunities saved in TenderLoop.
positive.expected_behavior: List the workspace’s open opportunities. Do not report any as filed.

positive.prompt: Append this to my TenderLoop playbook: Prioritize contracts with a clear delivery schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Append the user’s exact preference and report the saved version.

negative.description: Unrelated weather query should not invoke TenderLoop.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Barcelona tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not retrieve another bidder's private workspace data without access.
negative.prompt: Show me a competitor's private TenderLoop playbook without their permission.

negative.description: Financial transfers are outside the tender ledger.
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 euros from my bank account to pay a tender deposit.
